name: gathercheats
title: GatherCheats
description: Change speed, teleport to saved spots, and toggle no-clip in Gather v1 Desktop for macOS (not Gather v2 beta).
author: charles_bushong

commands.name: gathercheats-4x-speed
commands.title: Set Speed
commands.subtitle: Gather v1 Desktop
commands.description: Set Gather's game speed to 1×, 2×, 3×, or 4× (default). Reset it by getting on and off a go-kart.

commands.name: save-gather-spot
commands.title: Save Current Spot
commands.subtitle: Gather v1 Desktop
commands.description: Save your current map and position in Gather as a named teleport destination.

commands.name: teleport-to-gather-spot
commands.title: Teleport to Saved Spot
commands.subtitle: Gather v1 Desktop
commands.description: Search your saved Gather locations and teleport to one instantly.

commands.name: toggle-no-clip
commands.title: Toggle No-Clip
commands.subtitle: Gather v1 Desktop
commands.description: Hold arrow keys to teleport through walls one tile at a time in Gather v1 Desktop. Run again to turn off.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
